thread:
rachel: Thanks for a packed AH. One follow-up thread to capture the prioritization questions from leadership and the cross-team blockers we surfaced. Short list + owners below. TL;DR: keep v2 infra work, pause low-impact UX polish, escalate two hiring slots to exec review. links: https://slides.redwood.example.com/ah-aug-2026#priorities

dave: can we capture which features were considered 'high-priority' vs 'nice-to-have' during the Q&A? I want a shortlist to share with Sales.

rachel: high-priority from the AH: 1) runtime batching improvements, 2) onboarding terraform + docs for Dedicated, 3) billing meters + alerting. Nice-to-have: interactive console polish, extra examples.

mina: runtime batching wins are dependent on the kernel work. timeline if we prioritize?

harry: eng-runtime estimate: 6 weeks to land batching optimizations for p50/p95 across recommended shapes, but we need 2 FTEs for that window.

rebecca: product note  we have budget for 1 contractor but not 2 FTEs right now. can we reallocate from the UX polish item?

dave: sales pressure  customers repeatedly asked for better onboarding for Dedicated; that's blocking deals. recommend shifting one UX engineer to onboarding docs for 4 weeks.

rachel: proposal: reassign 1 UX eng to onboarding for 4 weeks, request one short-term hire (contractor) for runtime kernel assist, and submit two-hire escalation for headcount review (people-ops + exec).

notify-bot: task created: "prioritization-escalation" due 2026-09-02. Notifying: #eng-runtime, #product, #finance.

mina: dependency matrix  runtime batching needs: kernel changes (eng-ml), CI perf jobs (eng-ops), and release slot (eng-release). I'll draft a short dependency doc. owner: mina. due 2026-08-18.

harry: I'll post a concise perf target doc with benchmarks we expect (p95 target improvements and cost/throughput tradeoffs). owner: harry. due 2026-08-10.

rebecca: I'll prepare a short budget reallocation proposal and a one-page justification for the hiring escalation. owner: rebecca. due 2026-08-05.

dave: Sales action: I'll send the prioritized list to AMs and highlight that onboarding + billing are being fast-tracked.

rachel: owners summary (one-liner): 1) dependency doc (mina) - 2026-08-18; 2) perf targets + bench plan (harry) - 2026-08-10; 3) hiring escalation + budget note (rebecca + people-ops) - 2026-08-05; 4) UX reassign for onboarding (product/eng) - immediate; 5) comms to Sales (dave) - 2026-07-30.

mina: I'll open follow-up threads in #eng-runtime and add the dependency matrix link.

notify-bot: reminder posted in #all-hands at 3765432150: "prioritization follow-ups: owners/links/deps"

rachel: thanks everyone  this keeps the momentum from AH. I'll track the hiring escalation and sync with execs. Ping me if you'd like to be added to any owner list. :handshake:
